rows.note: Use 挑釁 as the all-purpose noun for a deliberate provocative or hostile act, including one intended to draw a reaction.

example.english: Their provocation of the opponent nearly started a fight.
example.traditional: 佢喺球場上面向對手挑釁，搞到大家差啲打起上嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 kau4 coeng4 soeng6 min6 hoeng3 deoi3 sau2 tiu1 jan6 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 caa1 di1 daa2 hei2 soeng5 lai4

rows.note: Use 激將法 specifically when someone provokes or challenges another person in order to make them do something.

example.english: Saying I didn’t dare go on stage alone was just provocation.
example.traditional: 佢話我唔敢一個人上台，其實只係用激將法。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 ngo5 m4 gam2 jat1 go3 jan4 soeng5 toi1 kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 jung6 gik1 zoeng3 faat3
